tasks.title: Decouple Monolithic Frontend into Modular ES Modules
tasks.description: Refactor static/index.html by extracting reusable modules into static/js/modules/ (api.js, family_tree.js, maps.js, print_engine.js) to improve maintainability and load times.

tasks.title: SQLite Composite Indexing for Sub-10ms Searches
tasks.description: Analyze query performance across the 1,994,357 records in voters.db and apply optimal composite B-Tree indexes on (ac_no, part_no, house_no), (epic_no), and (relative_name).
tasks.verification: python -c 'import sqlite3; conn=sqlite3.connect("voters.db"); print(conn.execute("EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN SELECT * FROM voters WHERE ac_no=15 AND part_no=42").fetchall())'

tasks.title: Automated Multi-Generational Kinship Test Suite
tasks.description: Develop tests/test_kinship.py containing unit tests for biological parent gender checks, spouse matching, sibling clustering, and multi-generational descent trees.

tasks.title: Client-Side DOM Sanitization & XSS Hardening
tasks.description: Audit all dynamic innerHTML interpolations in the frontend to ensure all voter names, relative names, and addresses are strictly attribute-escaped before insertion.

tasks.title: Progressive Web App (PWA) Offline Polling Station Cache
tasks.description: Implement service worker (sw.js) and manifest.json so BLOS and election workers can access previously loaded polling station maps and household slips without active 4G/5G signal.
